docs.title: Pivot Tables Migration Index & FK Audit
docs.summary: Audit of explicit indexes and cross-migration foreign keys. All 12 tables have explicit indexes (primary + secondary). Foreign keys referencing tables from other migrations: all except pivot_staff_pivotdepts.pivot_dept_id → pivot_dept_cate_branches (same migration).
docs.content:
## Tables Lacking Explicit Indexes

0 tables. All 12 tables in the migration have explicit indexes:

1. pivot_dept_cate_branches - indexes on department_id, category_id, branch_id
2. pivot_apoint_appraisals - indexes on evaluator_id, evaluatee_id, appraisal_category_id
3. pivot_category_appraisals - indexes on category_id, section_id
4. pivot_cross_backups - indexes on staff_id, backup_staff_id
5. pivot_leave_annuals - indexes on leave_id, leave_annual_id
6. pivot_leave_maternities - indexes on leave_id, leave_maternity_id
7. pivot_leave_mc - index on leave_id, index on leave_mc_id
8. pivot_leave_replacements - indexes on leave_id, leave_replacement_id
9. pivot_sales_job_description_get_items - indexes on sales_job_description_id, sales_get_item_id
10. pivot_sales_sales_delivery - indexes on sales_id, sales_delivery_id
11. pivot_staff_ci_category_item - indexes on staff_id, cicategory_item_id
12. pivot_staff_pivotdepts - indexes on staff_id, pivot_dept_id

## Foreign Keys Referencing Tables from Different Migration Files

All foreign keys reference tables created in other migrations, EXCEPT:

pivot_dept_cate_branches:
  - department_id → option_departments (created in 2026_08_06_165802_create_option_tables_part1.php)
  - category_id → option_categories (created in 2026_08_06_165802_create_option_tables_part1.php)
  - branch_id → option_branches (created in 2026_08_06_165802_create_option_tables_part1.php)

pivot_apoint_appraisals:
  - evaluator_id → staffs (created in 2026_08_08_100816_create_hr_staff_tables.php)
  - evaluatee_id → staffs (created in 2026_08_08_100816_create_hr_staff_tables.php)
  - appraisal_category_id → option_appraisal_categories (created in 2026_08_06_165802_create_option_tables_part1.php)

pivot_category_appraisals:
  - category_id → option_appraisal_categories (created in 2026_08_06_165802_create_option_tables_part1.php)
  - section_id → hr_appraisal_sections (created in 2026_08_06_165801_create_hr_appraisal_tables.php)

pivot_cross_backups:
  - staff_id → staffs (created in 2026_08_08_100816_create_hr_staff_tables.php)
  - backup_staff_id → staffs (created in 2026_08_08_100816_create_hr_staff_tables.php)

pivot_leave_annuals:
  - leave_id → hr_leaves (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)
  - leave_annual_id → hr_leave_annuals (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)

pivot_leave_maternities:
  - leave_id → hr_leaves (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)
  - leave_maternity_id → hr_leave_maternities (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)

pivot_leave_mc:
  - leave_id → hr_leaves (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)
  - leave_mc_id → hr_leave_mc (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)

pivot_leave_replacements:
  - leave_id → hr_leaves (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)
  - leave_replacement_id → hr_leave_replacements (created in 2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php)

pivot_sales_job_description_get_items:
  - sales_job_description_id → sales_job_descriptions (created in 2026_08_08_100818_create_sales_tables.php)
  - sales_get_item_id → option_sales_get_items (created in 2026_08_06_165802_create_option_tables_part1.php)

pivot_staff_ci_category_item:
  - staff_id → staffs (created in 2026_08_08_100816_create_hr_staff_tables.php)
  - cicategory_item_id → ci_category_items (created in 2026_08_06_165759_create_ci_tables.php)

pivot_staff_pivotdepts:
  - staff_id → staffs (created in 2026_08_08_100816_create_hr_staff_tables.php)
  - pivot_dept_id → pivot_dept_cate_branches (CREATED IN SAME MIGRATION - 2026_08_08_100824_create_pivot_tables.php)

## Summary
- Tables lacking explicit indexes: 0 of 12
- Foreign keys referencing tables from different migrations: 22 of 23
- Exception: pivot_staff_pivotdepts.pivot_dept_id → pivot_dept_cate_branches (same migration)
